title: Guided Walking Food Tour Experience in Kemah
includes: Water is included at every stop
We provide complimentary ponchos (If Rainy Season)
Visits to hidden gems and local favorites
Chef-selected food tastings from top local restaurants
Guided walking tour through Kemah’s historic Lighthouse District
Insider stories and local history from knowledgeable guides
Optional handcrafted beverages available for purchase (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: We recommend bringing a hearty appetite, comfortable footwear and clothing.
Please be aware that our menus are predetermined by the restaurants and cannot be customized. (All menus include gluten, shellfish, nuts, pork, sugar, and dairy.)
Please remember to bring a valid I.D. if you plan to partake in alcoholic beverages.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover Kemah’s Historic Lighthouse District on a 2+ hour guided food tour that lets you taste local favorites while soaking in the area’s rich culture and history. Stroll along charming waterfront streets, sample chef-selected dishes from top local restaurants, and uncover hidden gems that many visitors miss. This tour is perfect for couples, families, or groups looking to celebrate or simply enjoy a unique culinary adventure together.

- Guided walking tour through Kemah’s historic Lighthouse District
- Sample seasonal dishes from local chefs and top restaurants
- Explore hidden eateries and enjoy insider stories from knowledgeable guides
- Ideal for date nights, family outings, or group adventures with up to 18 guests
